message.content: {"skills": [{"slot": 1, "name": "下载器中间件 process_response 返回值路由", "description": "在下载器中间件的 process_response 钩子中，根据返回值类型决定后续链路走向：返回 Response 继续交给下一个中间件，返回 Request 中止链路并重新调度下载，抛出 IgnoreRequest 触发 errback。用于实现或调试响应处理中间件时。", "asset_type": "micro_skill", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "granularity": "micro", "objective": "按返回值类型正确路由 process_response 的后续处理", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "downloader_middleware", "method_family": "hook_return_dispatch", "stage": "response_processing", "use_when": ["编写或修改 process_response 方法", "需要根据响应结果决定继续、重调度或触发 errback"], "do_not_use_when": ["处理请求阶段逻辑（应使用 process_request）", "处理异常阶段逻辑（应使用 process_exception）"], "success_artifact": "process_response 返回 Response/Request 或抛出 IgnoreRequest，且链路行为符合预期", "why_distinct": "聚焦单一钩子的返回值分派规则，与异常处理钩子逻辑不同", "evidence_span_hint": "process_response() should either: return a Response object, return a Request object or raise a IgnoreRequest exception", "confidence": 0.85}, {"slot": 2, "name": "下载器中间件 process_exception 异常处理分派", "description": "在 process_exception 钩子中处理下载处理器或 process_request 抛出的异常：返回 None 继续传递异常，返回 Response 启动 process_response 链，返回 Request 重新调度。用于实现异常恢复或降级中间件。", "asset_type": "micro_skill", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "granularity": "micro", "objective": "按返回值类型正确分派 process_exception 的异常处理", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "downloader_middleware", "method_family": "hook_return_dispatch", "stage": "exception_handling", "use_when": ["编写或修改 process_exception 方法", "需要捕获下载异常并决定恢复、重试或继续抛出"], "do_not_use_when": ["处理正常响应阶段逻辑（应使用 process_response）", "处理请求发起阶段逻辑（应使用 process_request）"], "success_artifact": "process_exception 返回 None/Response/Request，异常处理链行为符合预期", "why_distinct": "针对异常钩子的分派规则，与 process_response 的正常响应路由不同", "evidence_span_hint": "process_exception() should return: either None, a Response object, or a Request object", "confidence": 0.85}]}
